environment.hardware: MacBook Air Mac14,2, Apple M2, 8 GiB unified memory
environment.storage: active artifact on internal APFS Apple Fabric storage; about 54 GB free after the sustained run
environment.host_protocol: Safari, VS Code, and optional applications were closed; Codex/ChatGPT remained open. Power source was allowed to vary naturally and was not an A/B factor.
environment.cache_protocol: F_NOCACHE was used for the expert pack in throughput runs; every process began with an empty bounded stable-slot cache.

implementation.mechanism: The native positional reader releases the Python GIL. On a cache miss, up to eight exact records are read concurrently into distinct reserved stable slots. Cache publication occurs only after all required reads complete successfully.
implementation.correctness: The router-selected expert IDs, top-K, weights, tensor layout, and MLX math are unchanged. A read failure clears reservations and raises; no substitute expert can be published.

storage_microbenchmark.order_control: Two repetitions used reversed serial/parallel order.

short_decode_ab.workload: Identical 64-token greedy generation, capacity 320, layer-partitioned decode cache, no prefetch
short_decode_ab.result: Exact output tokens and identical demand bytes/hits/misses; throughput +11.37%, demand pread -10.47%, with unchanged MLX peak.

sustained_8k.workload: 7,936 repeated raw prompt tokens plus 256 greedy output tokens
sustained_8k.configuration: 320 global prefill slots, 320 layer-partitioned decode slots, 512-token prefill chunks with allocator-cache clearing, F_NOCACHE, eight demand workers, adaptive prefetch budget 2/minimum 8 observations, 3 GiB admission budget
sustained_8k.decision: Accepted as the sustained qualification for eight-worker exact-demand reads. It exceeds the 2.0 tok/s gate, preserves the canonical output, and grows no swap. No repeat is required for this optimization.

rejected_eager_fence.result: Explicitly evaluating expert outputs to move deferred MLX work out of the router timing bucket reduced short-run decode from 2.357 to 2.262 and 2.144 tok/s. The timing bucket includes deferred GPU work and is not pure removable CPU synchronization. The fence is rejected.

excluded_run.description: A duplicate 8K attempt was interrupted during prefill after confirming that the apparent hash mismatch was only newline-sensitive serialization of the same token list.

decision.next_bottleneck: The runtime now reaches the measured approximately 1.65 GB/s queue-depth-eight internal-storage ceiling. Further gains require reducing/reorganizing physical reads or overlapping useful work, not repeating the same 8K qualification.
